name: Minecraft: Java Edition (Fabric)
description: Fabric Minecraft server with configurable version, memory and MOTD. Saves live in the server volume.

install.script:
set -e
echo 'Downloading Fabric server launcher'
curl -fsSL -o server.jar "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/{{MC_VERSION}}/{{FABRIC_LOADER}}/1.0.1/server/jar"
echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt
mkdir -p mods config
echo 'Install complete'

notes: Open the allocated port in your firewall. Set online-mode=false only for private testing.
